d: This episode of Tarikh tells the extraordinary story of Nizamuddin Auliya — the great Chishti Sufi saint who challenged the arrogance of sultans with nothing but compassion, fakiri, and faith. From the Mongol destruction of Bukhara to the streets of medieval Delhi, the episode traces his journey, his deep bond with Amir Khusro, the origins of Basant celebrations at the dargah, and the famous saying “Hanooz Dilli Door Ast.” It explores hunger, spirituality, politics, love, and devotion in the Delhi Sultanate era — and how a humble fakir became “Mahboob-e-Ilahi,” the beloved of God.
